svg.title: Flow suite complete issue atlas — 2026-10-06T16:18:58.475611+00:00
svg.desc: All 150 manifest nodes, grouped by repository and work group. NUKED means the bounded issue is complete, not that all checks or releases are complete. Cards link to their source issues. Dependency relationships are in the companion map.
